name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA: flu low but GP positivity rising, COVID low, RSV at baseline; consultants strike 25–26 Nov
state: UKHSA's 29 Oct report, covering 19–25 Oct, showed flu circulating at low levels with GP swab positivity up from 7.8% to 11.0%, COVID-19 low and easing, and RSV rising but at baseline (UKHSA). A later report was not visible in searches on 6 Nov. Consultants in England strike on 25–26 Nov (NHS Employers). No widespread critical incidents had been reported.
for_you: NHS advice is to get a flu vaccine if eligible and to use NHS 111 for urgent but non-emergency care. Expect fewer planned appointments on strike days.
rubric_hit: Normal: flu, COVID and RSV at low or baseline levels; no widespread critical incidents

why: Winter respiratory waves and NHS capacity directly affect access to care for everyone in the UK.
drivers: Flu, COVID, RSV, norovirus, staffing, strikes.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
rubric.watch: Respiratory activity above baseline and rising, or several trusts in critical incidents.
rubric.normal: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.
